rung: short-term 3: first bounded offboard PPO run, install its policy, one rollout

plan.written: before the trainer started; committed ahead of the run so the ordering is in git
plan.trainer: training/cadex_train.py under ~/cadex-train-venv (jax backend gpu, checked); offboard, the engine is not in the process
plan.task: the accepted balance_task, unchanged: task sha256 1f8c1040..., MJCF 933b1ac6...
plan.training_seed_note: outside 0-9 so no one mistakes it for an evaluation seed; the trainer draws resets from jax.random, not random.Random(seed)

settings.note: iterations, envs, seed, label are cadex train flags; the rest are the trainer's defaults, which cadex train does not override

plan.step_budget: 300 iterations x 1024 envs x 20 unroll = 6,144,000 environment steps (control steps at 50 Hz)
plan.stop_rule: the trainer stops at 300 iterations or at the 2400 s --timeout, whichever comes first; no early stop on reward, no restart inside this unit. Timeout without a policy = interrupted; non-zero exit or non-finite curve = failed; either is kept and reported and the next unit decides the next run
plan.success_is_not: trainer exit, reward, or a single rollout; only the frozen ten-seed evaluation (rung 4) can pass the bar
plan.after_training: install by the README's digest edit (cadex script literals -> stored name and sha256, cadex script --set, cadex params --set policy_on=1), witness-verified at rebuild; then one rollout at rollout_seed=0 read by runner/balance_eval.py after checking the trace has 401 frames for 400 steps
plan.accounting: per README Run accounting: completed / failed / interrupted / void; void if the bundle's MJCF or task sha256 differs from the pin

model: none: no product turn dispatched; training is the offboard PPO trainer

policy.checkpoint: final iteration (299), not the best-iteration checkpoint

training.episode_steps_note: the trainer's 'episode' figure exceeds 400 late in training (409.6 at the last iteration, 1861.8 at 295), so it is not an 8 s truncated-episode length; it is not read as a balance measurement here

installation.method: README Installation: cadex script (read) -> cadex_cli.walk.declare_policy rewrote the two literals only (weights, sha256) -> cadex script --set -> cadex params --set policy_on=1

declare.digest_note: unchanged: the switch is still 0, so the rollout is not built

policy_on.engine_verified: the rebuild ran assembly.policy against the stored file and its sha256 and accepted, so the engine's witness check passed

rollout_seed_0.note: one diagnostic rollout at the script's default rollout_seed=0; NOT the frozen ten-seed evaluation (rung 4), and not reported as B3 evidence

diagnostics.drift_note: the task rewards alive and pitch only; nothing holds position or heading, so the policy balances while wandering ~0.84 m and turning. Not part of the bar; recorded for the next diagnosis
